# Paper G: Gradient Memo Card

## g1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_gradient; SECTION_KEY=g1_scope]
Paper Gradient Card USES GradientMemo. GradientMemo TARGETS Experiment Recall by linking experimental decisions with later review questions.

## g2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_gradient; SECTION_KEY=g2_dataset]
GradientMemo is EVALUATED_ON TimelineQA. TimelineQA is a Dataset containing synthetic dated note fragments and follow-up prompts.

## g3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_gradient; SECTION_KEY=g3_metric]
GradientMemo REPORTS Complete Evidence Recall. It uses the Metric to check whether timeline facts and method facts appear together.

## g4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_gradient; SECTION_KEY=g4_concept]
GradientMemo USES Query Paraphrase. Query Paraphrase is a Concept where the question changes wording but keeps the same retrieval intent.

## g5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_gradient; SECTION_KEY=g5_compare]
Paper Gradient Card COMPARES_WITH HarborQA. GradientMemo favors memory recall, while HarborQA favors grounded question answering.
